physicalNotes: Radius 1.2 Jupiter radii, the model radius Marois et al. (2008, Science 322, 1348) adopt for the companions and the NASA Exoplanet Archive carries as the default for this planet: 85,790 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. Not a measured diameter: the planet is unresolved. GM from the dynamical mass 5.80 Jupiter masses of Zurlo et al. (2022, A&A 666, A133, Table 3 model 1) times Jupiter's GM 126686531.9 km^3/s^2. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

prediction.reference: whereistheplanet (Wang et al. 2021) distributes a GRAVITY orbit fit for the four planets, not yet published; it is what Sallum et al. (2026, arXiv:2609.10507) predict these planets with.
